{{Quote|Unfortunately for you, Lau has a very strict pet policy.|Captain Mann, to Omega|<ref name="A Different Approach" />}}
'''Lau''' was a [[planet]] in the [[Meerian sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories]]. After Omega and Crosshair fled Imperial facility on [[Wayland]], they ended up on Lau before they managed to steal and [[Starship|ship]] and leave the planet.

==Description==
Lau was a largely desolate [[planet]] with a cold and windy climate<ref name="Databank Lau" /> and a landscape featuring jagged cliffs and plains. During the [[Imperial Era]], it maintained an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] presence, with [[TK stormtrooper]]s patrolling the streets of the [[Unidentified town (Lau)|main settlement]].<ref name="A Different Approach" />

==History==
During or after [[18 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TBBDate|304}}</ref> the [[Cloning|clones]] [[Omega]] and [[Crosshair]] crash-landed there while fleeing the [[Advanced Science Division]] on [[Wayland]]. A [[Cargo Dock Clash|skirmish]] on Lau occurred after Imperial [[Captain]] [[Mann]] attempted to capture Omega and Crosshair, albeit unsuccessfully. The pair managed to steal a [[Starship|ship]] and leave the planet, eventually reuniting with their [[Clone Force 99|squad]].<ref name="A Different Approach" />
